SERVICE OF COMPLAINT BY CERTIFIED MAIL FILED BY PLAINTIFF GETMAN, MARGOT AS TO DEFENDANT AIRBNB
PROOF OF SERVICE FILED ON CLAIM OF PLAINTIFF SERVED AUG-11-2022, COURT CERTIFIED MAIL RETURNED SERVED AS TO DEFENDANT AIRBNB

DECLARATION RE: REQUEST TO APPEAR AT HEARING BY ZOOM FILED BY DEFENDANT AIRBNB

ORDER RE: REQUEST TO APPEAR AT HEARING BY ZOOM(DEFENDANT)**GRANTED**

SMALL CLAIMS CALENDAR OF SEP-27-2022 - TAKEN UNDER SUBMISSION AS OF SEP-27-2022 BY JUDGE PRO TEM DAVID LAVINE. PLAINTIFF MARGOT GETMAN IS PRESENT VIA UNAUTHORIZED ZOOM APPEARANCE. DEFENDANT AIRBNB IS PRESENT VIA ZOOM, REPRESENTED BY DAN MCDOWELL, REPRESENTATIVE. PLAINTIFF AND DEFENDANT BOTH ORALLY STIPULATE TO JUDGE PRO TEM. COURT GRANTS ZOOM APPEARANCE TO PLAINTIFF MARGOT GETMAN. DEFENDANT EXHIBITS RETAINED. JUDGE PRO TEM: DAVID LAVINE; CLERK: D. AU. NOT REPORTED. (D506)
SMALL CLAIMS HEARING OF SEP-27-2022 - JUDGMENT.

THE COURT HAS ORDERED THE FOLLOWING JUDGMENT ENTERED: IT IS ADJUDGED THAT PLAINTIFF GETMAN, MARGOT IS NOT OWED ANY MONEY BY DEFENDANT AIRBNB PLAINTIFF DID NOT ESTABLISH A BREACH OF CONTRACT BY AIRBNB. STAY OF EXECUTION 30 DAYS DEFENDANT'S EXHIBITS RECEIVED
